QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] It Ain't Natural
QuestInfo.0: Listen to the story about the Stone Colossus from #bTatamo#k, the chief of #bLeafre#k.
QuestInfo.1: Tatamo thinks, if the rock mountain really is a colossus, that it could be dangerous. He wants you to investigate the colossus with the exploration team to confirm. Go to the Explorer Base.
QuestInfo.2: You agreed to Chief Tatamo's request, went to the Explorer Base, and met Valerie, who's here on an Alliance mission for the same reason...

1.0: A Pirate like myself doesn't come all the way to a rock mountain for nothing, you know. I'm here on an #bAlliance mission#k. They #rsuspect Stone Colossus might be working for the Black Mage#k.
1.1: It's speculation, of course, but the Alliance wants anything even remotely related to the Black Mage to be investigated thoroughly. They want to be absolutely sure.
1.2: You have to admit, it's a little strange that a rock mountain just moved after ages of being still. So, I'm here to investigate.

npc.0: Please confirm whether the rock mountain is living, and if so, #bfind out whether the colossus is hostile towards Halflingers and other beings of Minar Forest#k.
npc.1: To start, head to the Explorer Base the right of #bForest: Crossroad#k. An #badventurer#k went there not too long ago. You might run into each other.
